title: Glowing glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bffcff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3fd0ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lens1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8ef0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a9fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lens2' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8ef0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a9fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='28' fill='#1a4a66' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- temples (arms) -->
  <rect x='6' y='48' width='14' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <rect x='80' y='48' width='14' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <!-- left lens frame -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='50' r='19' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='50' r='14' fill='url(#lens1)'/>
  <!-- right lens frame -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='19' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='14' fill='url(#lens2)'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='46' y='45' width='11' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- lens shine highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='44' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='44' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- cute glowing sparkle on top -->
  <path d='M50 8 l2.2 5.2 5.2 2.2 -5.2 2.2 -2.2 5.2 -2.2 -5.2 -5.2 -2.2 5.2 -2.2 z' fill='url(#glow)'/>
</svg>
